description: The same element carrying `of=@signup.name`, a validator-bearing compound field. Isolates the missing attribute from the element.
rationale: §55.8 — `<errors of=expr/>` renders the validation errors OF a named cell or compound. Without `of=` the element names no subject, so there is no error list to render and nothing the compiler could default to — a bare `<errors/>` would render silently empty, which is the worst outcome for a diagnostic surface.
